info.title: Laplace modular browser boundary — proposed contract
info.description: DESIGN PROPOSAL. These paths are not implemented or deployed. Existing native /v1 endpoints remain the semantic owner; the browser gateway owns sessions, resource authorization and integration orchestration. Operation input/output schemas are discoverable and preserve full invention scope.
